name: Latin
blurb: Learn the five declensions and their cases, the four conjugations, sum and possum, the core tenses and about 700 high-frequency words, phrases and mottos, so you can start reading real Latin, from Caesar to the Vulgate and the Mass. No browser has a Latin voice, so audio uses an Italian voice, close to church pronunciation.

sources.t: Dickinson College Commentaries, Latin Core Vocabulary
Allen and Greenough, New Latin Grammar (DCC edition)
B. L. D'Ooge, Latin for Beginners (Project Gutenberg)
Biblia Sacra Vulgata (Stuttgart edition), Deutsche Bibelgesellschaft
